header.introDesc: A proctored, timed run of generated cases with guidance switched off, ending in a scored competency report.

proctored.title: Proctored, one pass
proctored.body: You work each case once. There is no retry within a case.

timed.title: Timed per case
timed.body: A countdown runs on every case; it auto-submits at zero.

noGuidance.title: Guidance is off
noGuidance.body: Real-time hints and attending tips are disabled throughout.

scored.title: Scored report
scored.body: You get a competency report at the end, saved to this device.

intro.mixHint: Leave every family off to draw across all systems, or pick specific ones.

intro.sourceLocal: Cases are generated on-device for this exam.
